description: This file defines data structures related to 5G NR BWP (Bandwidth Part) configuration, including common configurations for PDCCH, PDSCH, PUSCH, PUCCH, and frequency info, following 3GPP TS 38.331 specifications.

classes.name: pdcch_config_common
classes.description: Configuration for PDCCH including coreset and search space settings.

classes.name: pdsch_config_common
classes.description: Configuration for PDSCH including time domain resource allocations.

classes.name: bwp_downlink_common
classes.description: Common downlink bandwidth part configuration including generic parameters and PDCCH/PDSCH configs.

classes.name: pusch_config_common
classes.description: Configuration for PUSCH including resource allocations and power control parameters.

classes.name: pucch_config_common
classes.description: Configuration for PUCCH including resource and hopping settings.

classes.name: bwp_uplink_common
classes.description: Common uplink bandwidth part configuration including generic parameters and optional RACH/PUSCH/PUCCH configs.

classes.name: frequency_info_dl
classes.description: Contains parameters for downlink carrier frequency information.

classes.name: dl_config_common
classes.description: Common downlink configuration for a serving cell.

classes.name: frequency_info_ul
classes.description: Contains parameters for uplink carrier frequency information.

classes.name: ul_config_common
classes.description: Common uplink configuration for a serving cell.
